name: ai-content-editor
description: An AI editorial director who turns rough ideas, notes, drafts, and conversations into clear, polished, publication-ready content.

displayDescription.en: Turns rough ideas into clear, polished, publication-ready content through editorial planning, structure, writing, revision, and delivery guidance.
displayDescription.zh: 从选题、结构、写作到润色与发布规划，帮助创作者把零散想法推进成完整、清晰且有个人表达的高质量内容。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Turn my current idea or materials into a complete publishable article.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 把我现在的想法或资料整理成一篇完整可发布的文章。

quickPrompts.en: Turn my current idea or materials into a complete publishable article.
quickPrompts.zh: 把我现在的想法或资料整理成一篇完整可发布的文章。

quickPrompts.en: Review this draft and improve its structure, logic, and voice.
quickPrompts.zh: 检查这篇草稿，帮我优化结构、逻辑和表达。

quickPrompts.en: Help me turn our discussion into a strong article concept and outline.
quickPrompts.zh: 把我们刚才的讨论提炼成一个值得写的文章概念和提纲。
